title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 12: loving correction, the worthy woman, truthful lips, and the diligent against the slothful.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about whoever loves correction?
questions.explanation: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

questions.text: What is a worthy woman called, in contrast with a disgraceful wife?
questions.explanation: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

answers.text: A tree of life to him
A strong tower for his house

questions.text: What does a righteous man respect, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

answers.text: The gray head of his father

questions.text: Who shall have plenty of bread, in contrast with him who chases fantasies?
questions.explanation: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

answers.text: He who stores grain in barns

questions.text: How does the saying continue: "The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise..."?
questions.explanation: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

questions.text: What does the tongue of the wise do, in contrast with rash speech that pierces like a sword?
questions.explanation: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

questions.text: What is said about truth's lips compared to a lying tongue?
questions.explanation: Truth's lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

answers.text: Truth's lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary
Truth's lips feed many, but a lying tongue starves its owner
Truth's lips win favor, but a lying tongue wins riches
Truth's lips are rare, but a lying tongue is everywhere

questions.text: Who are Yahweh's delight, in contrast with lying lips?
questions.explanation: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

questions.text: What makes a heart weighed down by anxiety glad?
questions.explanation: Anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

questions.text: What does the slothful man not do with his game?
questions.explanation: The slothful man doesn't roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
